name: INNEOVA Holdings Limited
summary: INNEOVA Holdings Ltd operates as a parent company, overseeing various subsidiary businesses. Through these operating units, the firm is dedicated to manufacturing essential aftermarket components for a broad spectrum of combustion engines, encompassing both automotive applications and those utilized in non-vehicular industrial settings. INNEOVA Holdings' global presence allows it to supply and support diverse sectors such as maritime operations, power generation, resource extraction (mining), agriculture, as well as the oil & gas and construction industries across the world.
